things.description: This model connects light paths to positions in an image. It does not attempt to model perception in the brain.

things.label: Vanishing point
things.description: In this construction, a family of parallel lines receding from the picture plane converges at a point.

things.label: Perspective grid
things.description: A geometric guide to constructing depth from a chosen viewpoint; not the only legitimate way to depict space.

things.label: Perspective drawing
things.description: The plan is projected into a view from one chosen eye position.

things.label: Scaled architectural view
things.description: Measured proportions connect the imagined view to the courtyard plan. It can guide comparison without claiming a painted view is a complete survey.

things.label: Paint
things.description: Pigment supplies color; a binder holds it together and attaches it to a surface. Different media afford different marks.

args: Voluntary stop in painting workshop after optics goals and scaled architectural view. 24 attempts, 15 accepted, 13 creations, 3 hints. Enjoyed pinhole placement leading to inverted image, camera obscura, then optical experiment; this had a concrete causal thread. Perspective construction chain was legible after one failed parallel-lines plus horizon guess, but then felt routine. Generic failures for aperture plus dark room, barrier plus aperture, image plus protocol, and paint plus drawing or light study do not distinguish an incomplete setup from a bad concept. Focused image plus light ray felt like an abstract naming gate after ray already produced refraction. Projection construction explanation merely restates its ingredients. I stopped because I was losing interest in finding the prescribed intermediate noun for the painting; I wanted a visible consequence or richer feedback instead. No claim about human enjoyment or graphical interface. Did not see chance stage. Blind player protocol maintained; no source or scenario read.
